sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在早上4点30分给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 在太空中走过七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星星的彼端有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我在测试七张床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联赛中最出色的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用一个不同的起始词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one-pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 而且我很喜欢一锅端的食谱，因为我不爱洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝成立175周年，持续助您理解世界，过好每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，访问 nytimes.com slash subscribe 享受优惠。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗，《纽约时报》为您报道。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: On Thursday night, a grand jury indicted the former director of the FBI, James Comey, in a case that Trump has personally demanded that federal prosecutors pursue,
sentences.zh: 周四晚上，大陪审团起诉了前联邦调查局局长詹姆斯·科米，这是一起特朗普曾亲自要求联邦检察官推进的案件，

sentences.en: despite their own serious doubts about whether Comey committed a crime.
sentences.zh: 尽管检察官自己对科米是否犯罪抱有严重怀疑。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Devlin Barrett on what's in the indictment and what it means for Trump's ongoing campaign of retribution.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事德夫林·巴雷特将解读起诉书的内容，以及它对特朗普持续展开的报复行动意味着什么。

sentences.en: It's Friday, September 26th.
sentences.zh: 今天是9月26日，星期五。

sentences.en: Devlin, it's late at night, 9.15 on Thursday night, and I'm grateful for you making time for us.
sentences.zh: 德夫林，现在很晚了，周四晚上9点15分，很感谢你抽空接受我们的采访。

sentences.en: Happy to be here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴来到这里。

sentences.en: This, Devlin, is an indictment that we're going to be talking about that President Trump has always wanted to bring against James Comey, his longtime nemesis.
sentences.zh: 德夫林，这是一份我们一直在讨论的起诉书，特朗普总统一直想对他的长期死敌詹姆斯·科米提起诉讼。

sentences.en: But it's an indictment that almost every government prosecutor that has looked at it has actually said, we don't want to bring it
sentences.zh: 但几乎所有看过这份起诉书的政府检察官都曾表示，我们不想提起诉讼

sentences.en: because they didn't think there was enough evidence to ever get to a conviction.
sentences.zh: 因为他们认为证据不足以定罪。

sentences.en: And yet, here we are.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们现在却走到了这一步。

sentences.en: Yeah, this is a huge moment for the country.
sentences.zh: 是的，这对国家来说是一个极其重大的时刻。

sentences.en: You have a former FBI director indicted.
sentences.zh: 你看到了一位前联邦调查局局长遭到起诉。

sentences.en: And it's huge for a bunch of reasons.
sentences.zh: 这在很多方面都意义重大。

sentences.en: But I think most importantly, it is the culmination.
sentences.zh: 但我认为最重要的是，这是一个高潮。

sentences.en: It is the result of a very public and incessant campaign of retribution by President Trump to use the justice system that he resents, that he distrusts, that went after him,
sentences.zh: 这是特朗普总统公开且不间断地展开报复行动的结果。他要利用自己所痛恨、不信任且曾针对过他的司法系统，

sentences.en: to instead use that system to pursue his enemies, to use DOJ as a tool against the people that he blames for his own legal probleMs.
sentences.zh: 转而用这个系统去追捕政敌，将司法部当作对付那些他认为是他们导致了自己法律麻烦的人的工具。

sentences.en: And that makes for a frankly scary and tumultuous and uncertain moment at the entire Justice Department
sentences.zh: 坦白说，这让整个司法部陷入了一个令人恐惧、动荡且不确定的时刻，

sentences.en: because I don't think anyone who works in that space thinks Trump is going to stop with the indictment of Jim Comey.
sentences.zh: 因为我认为任何在这个领域工作的人都不认为特朗普会止步于起诉吉姆·科米。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I think just to start, we should put this indictment into that context you just laid out of Trump seeing the Department of Justice as really a tool for personal retribution,
sentences.zh: 我认为首先我们应该把这份起诉书放在你刚才提到的背景中，即特朗普将司法部视为个人报复的工具，

sentences.en: very specifically against Comey and just how committed Trump has been to the idea of prosecuting Comey at this point for pretty much a decade.
sentences.zh: 特别针对科米，而且特朗普在过去差不多十年里一直执着于起诉科米。

sentences.en: So you really need to go back to 2017 when Trump is a new president.
sentences.zh: 所以我们真的需要回到2017年，当时特朗普刚刚当选总统。

sentences.en: James Comey is a veteran FBI director at that point.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯·科米当时是联邦调查局的一位资深局长。

sentences.en: And within a matter of months, those two people just distrust each other more and more and more because Comey is leading an investigation into people in Trump's orbit.
sentences.zh: 在几个月的时间里，这两个人彼此越来越不信任，因为科米正在领导一项针对特朗普核心圈子成员的调查。

sentences.en: This is the Russia investigation.
sentences.zh: 这就是通俄门调查。

sentences.en: Did the Trump campaign collude with Russia?
sentences.zh: 特朗普竞选团队是否与俄罗斯勾结？

sentences.en: Trump's now president.
sentences.zh: 特朗普现在是总统了。

sentences.en: He hates the existence of this investigation.
sentences.zh: 他痛恨这项调查的存在。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And Comey sort of famously described being pressed for a pledge of loyalty from President Trump and trying to politely refuse to do that.
sentences.zh: 科米曾有一段名言，描述了特朗普总统如何向他施压要求效忠宣誓，而他则试图礼貌地拒绝。

sentences.en: Having a president like Donald Trump and an FBI director like Jim Comey is a combustible combination.
sentences.zh: 拥有唐纳德·特朗普这样的总统和吉姆·科米这样的联邦调查局局长，是一个极其危险的组合。

sentences.en: And in May of 2017, Trump fires Comey.
sentences.zh: 在2017年5月，特朗普解雇了科米。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Quite memorably.
sentences.zh: 令人印象深刻。

sentences.en: Yeah, quite memorably, quite dramatically.
sentences.zh: 是的，非常令人难忘，也非常具有戏剧性。

sentences.en: And that itself sets off a series of events that leads to a special counsel being appointed to investigate Donald Trump over the entire Russia question.
sentences.zh: 这本身就引发了一系列事件，导致了一名特别检察官被任命来调查唐纳德·特朗普涉嫌通俄的整个问题。

sentences.en: Which only deepens his disgust and his fury with Comey.
sentences.zh: 这只会加深他对科米的厌恶和愤怒。

sentences.en: Well, exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Look, he's a showboat.
sentences.zh: 听着，他是个哗众取宠的人。

sentences.en: He's a grandstander.
sentences.zh: 他是个爱出风头的人。

sentences.en: The FBI has been in turmoil.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局一直处于动荡之中。

sentences.en: You know that.
sentences.zh: 你知道的。

sentences.en: I know that.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: Everybody knows that.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道。

sentences.en: And my sense is that even in 2017, pretty much right after he fires James Comey,
sentences.zh: 我的感觉是，早在2017年，几乎就在他解雇詹姆斯·科米之后，

sentences.en: Trump develops a desire to prosecute him.
sentences.zh: 特朗普就产生了起诉他的愿望。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Because what's happening in that time period is the special counsel investigation is ramping up.
sentences.zh: 因为在那段时间里发生的事情是，特别检察官调查正在加剧。

sentences.en: This is becoming a bigger problem for the president.
sentences.zh: 这对总统来说成了一个更大的麻烦。

sentences.en: No collusion.
sentences.zh: 没有勾结。

sentences.en: No obstruction.
sentences.zh: 没有妨碍司法。

sentences.en: He's a leaker.
sentences.zh: 他是个泄密者。

sentences.en: And he increasingly blames those problems on Comey, who he calls a phony, who he calls a leaker.
sentences.zh: 他越来越把这些问题归咎于科米，他称科米是冒牌货，称他是泄密者。

sentences.en: President Trump launched a Sunday morning tweet storm aimed at Comey.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统发起了一场针对科米的周日早晨推特风暴。

sentences.en: The president called Comey a slime ball.
sentences.zh: 总统称科米是个卑鄙小人。

sentences.en: President Trump struck back on Twitter this morning saying James Comey is a proven leaker and liar.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统今天早上在推特上回击称，詹姆斯·科米是一个名副其实的泄密者和骗子。

sentences.en: Who he is deeply, deeply suspicious of and thinks is just out there trying to manipulate the government to cause Trump problems and to investigate Trump.
sentences.zh: 他对其抱有深深的怀疑，认为他一心只想操纵政府来给特朗普制造麻烦并调查特朗普。

sentences.en: He also called the former FBI director, quote, disgruntled and said Comey and others, quote, committed many crimes.
sentences.zh: 他还称这位前联邦调查局局长为“心怀不满的人”，并表示科米和其他人“犯下了许多罪行”。

sentences.en: And just to be fair to Trump in this moment, as I recall, Comey eventually makes clear that he did want a special counsel.
sentences.zh: 为了对特朗普保持公正，我记得科米后来确实明确表示，他确实想要一个特别检察官。

sentences.en: He did want certain memos he wrote to become public.
sentences.zh: 他确实希望他写的一些备忘录公之于众。

sentences.en: And he did believe that the president should be further investigated.
sentences.zh: 他也确实相信应该对总统进行进一步调查。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Comey admitted eventually to putting certain information out that he wanted out there because he thought it was important.
sentences.zh: 科米最终承认发布了一些他希望公开的信息，因为他认为这很重要。

sentences.en: And there are a number of criticisms that are made of Comey's conduct, mostly of his judgment.
sentences.zh: 人们对科米的行为提出了许多批评，主要是针对他的判断力。

sentences.en: But time after time, what you see in that period is prosecutors looking at Comey's actions and deciding these aren't really crimes.
sentences.zh: 但一次又一次，你在那个时期看到的是，检察官们审查了科米的行为后认为这些并不算真正的犯罪。

sentences.en: And that frustrates Trump.
sentences.zh: 这让特朗普感到沮丧。

sentences.en: And it becomes sort of a very sore point with him that, you know, why can't he find a prosecutor?
sentences.zh: 这对他来说成了一个非常痛点的问题，你知道，为什么他就找不到一个检察官？

sentences.en: Why can't he find an attorney general?
sentences.zh: 为什么他就找不到一个总检察长？

sentences.en: Why can't he find someone loyal enough to him to charge Jim Comey with a crime?
sentences.zh: 为什么他就找不到一个对他足够忠诚、敢于指控吉姆·科米犯罪的人？

sentences.en: And then, as I recall, the first term comes to an end.
sentences.zh: 然后，我记得第一任期结束了。

sentences.en: There is no prosecution of Jim Comey, as Trump wants.
sentences.zh: 并没有像特朗普所希望的那样对吉姆·科米提起诉讼。

sentences.en: So once Trump gets elected to a second term, what is he doing with his deeply held vengeance for Jim Comey?
sentences.zh: 所以，一旦特朗普当选连任，他将如何处理对吉姆·科米根深蒂固的复仇心理？

sentences.en: And how do we get to this point?
sentences.zh: 我们又是如何走到这一步的？

sentences.en: He's telling anyone who will listen and, most importantly, the people who work for him in the government, they indicted me, now they need to be indicted.
sentences.zh: 他告诉任何愿意听的人，最重要的是告诉他在政府里为他工作的人：他们起诉了我，现在他们必须被起诉。

sentences.en: And in Trump's mind, at the top of that list is Jim Comey.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普的心目中，这个名单的榜首就是吉姆·科米。

sentences.en: And he starts pushing senior Justice Department officials who are, in many instances, his former criminal defense lawyers,
sentences.zh: 他开始向高级司法部官员施压，在许多情况下，这些人曾是他的刑事辩护律师，

sentences.en: he starts pushing them harder and harder and harder to make a criminal case against Comey.
sentences.zh: 他开始越来越严厉地向他们施压，要求对科米提起刑事诉讼。

sentences.en: But just ordering it isn't enough to necessarily make it happen.
sentences.zh: 但仅仅下达命令并不足以让它必然发生。

sentences.en: The Justice Department is not simply a top-down structure that solely follows orders.
sentences.zh: 司法部不是一个单纯的自上而下、只知盲目服从命令的结构。

sentences.en: There are career prosecutors who are tasked with looking at this.
sentences.zh: 有职业检察官负责审查此事。

sentences.en: This case ends up being in the Eastern District of Virginia office.
sentences.zh: 这个案件最终落在了弗吉尼亚州东区检察官办公室。

sentences.en: And the prosecutors there look at the evidence and say, you know, this is not a good case.
sentences.zh: 那里的检察官审阅了证据后表示，你知道，这不是一个好案子。

sentences.en: This is not a chargeable crime.
sentences.zh: 这不是一起可以起诉的罪行。

sentences.en: And it wasn't just career prosecutors.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是职业检察官这么认为。

sentences.en: It was also the Republican pick to run the federal prosecutor's office in the Eastern District of Virginia.
sentences.zh: 这也是负责管理弗吉尼亚州东区联邦检察官办公室的共和党人选的看法。

sentences.en: And he, too, told his superiors, this is not a good case.
sentences.zh: 他也告诉上级，这不是一个好案子。

sentences.en: This is not a case that should be charged.
sentences.zh: 这不是一个应该被起诉的案件。

sentences.en: It's simply weak.
sentences.zh: 它实在是太薄弱了。

sentences.en: And unlike the first term, when Trump often essentially settled for being told no, even though he didn't like it, he doesn't settle for that this time.
sentences.zh: 与第一任期不同，当时特朗普虽然不喜欢，但基本上默认了被拒绝的结果，而这一次他绝不善罢甘休。

sentences.en: This time, he forces out this Republican lawyer and he puts in instead a White House aide who is very loyal to the president, a lawyer who has zero prosecutorial experience.
sentences.zh: 这一次，他逼走了这位共和党律师，转而安插了一位对总统绝对忠诚的白宫助手，一个零诉讼经验的律师。

sentences.en: And she pushes forward with this case that her own staff has already said is a bad case and shouldn't be brought.
sentences.zh: 她不顾自己手下员工已经说过这是个烂案子、不应起诉的意见，执意推动这个案件。

sentences.en: But he doesn't stop there.
sentences.zh: 但他并没有就此罢休。

sentences.en: He publicly calls on his attorney general, Pam Bondi, to push forward and get an indictment.
sentences.zh: 他公开呼吁总检察长帕姆·邦迪推进此事并获取起诉书。

sentences.en: It's basically a public order to keep going.
sentences.zh: 这基本上是一个要求继续推进的公开命令。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it seems like he's finally gotten all the elements in place.
sentences.zh: 看起来他终于把所有的棋子都就位了。

sentences.en: He's got an attorney general who will pretty much do whatever he wants.
sentences.zh: 他有了一个基本上会听从他任何吩咐的总检察长。

sentences.en: He's fired the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他解雇了阻挠这一切的美国

sentences.en: attorney standing in the way.
sentences.zh: 检察官。

sentences.en: And he's installed a replacement who seems as loyal as Bondi and ready to go for it.
sentences.zh: 并且他安插了一个新的人选，看起来和邦迪一样忠诚，已经准备好大干一场了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So that, I think, pretty much brings us to today when that new U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以，我想这差不多把我们带到了今天，这位新任的美国

sentences.en: attorney replacing the old one who didn't think this case had enough evidence to ever get anywhere
sentences.zh: 检察官取代了那位认为本案证据不足、无法推进的前任，

sentences.en: brings an indictment to the grand jury and the grand jury accepts it and indicts Jim Comey.
sentences.zh: 将起诉书提交给大陪审团，大陪审团接受了并起诉了吉姆·科米。

sentences.en: So let's talk about what's actually in that indictment.
sentences.zh: 那么我们来谈谈起诉书里到底写了什么。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The indictment is about Jim Comey's testimony to a Senate committee back in September 30th, 2020.
sentences.zh: 起诉书涉及吉姆·科米在2020年9月30日对参议院委员会的作证。

sentences.en: That date is important because the statute of limitations for false testimony to Congress is five years.
sentences.zh: 这个日期很重要，因为向国会作伪证的诉讼时效是五年。

sentences.en: The statute of limitations in this case is set to expire next Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 本案的诉讼时效定于下周二到期。

sentences.en: So whatever Trump wanted and whatever Trump's loyal soldiers were going to do, they had to do it this week or at the latest by next Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 因此，无论特朗普想要什么，无论特朗普的忠诚手下要做什么，他们都必须在本周完成，或者最迟在下周二完成。

sentences.en: So that explains the urgency.
sentences.zh: 这就解释了这种紧迫性。

sentences.en: What in the indictment is Comey alleged to have done illegally that relates to that Senate testimony from 2020?
sentences.zh: 起诉书指控科米做了什么与2020年参议院证词相关的违法行为？

sentences.en: So Comey is accused in this indictment of lying to the Senate based on an exchange he had in that hearing with Senator Ted Cruz, a Republican from Texas.
sentences.zh: 所以科米在这份起诉书中被指控在参议院作证时撒谎，这源于他在听证会上与来自德克萨斯州的共和党参议员泰德·克鲁斯的对话。

sentences.en: Thank you, Mr. Chairman.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，主席先生。

sentences.en: Returning to Mr. Comey.
sentences.zh: 回到科米先生的话题。

sentences.en: Mr. Comey.
sentences.zh: 科米先生。

sentences.en: And in that hearing, Senator Cruz asks him.
sentences.zh: 在听证会上，克鲁斯参议员问他。

sentences.en: On May 3rd, 2017.
In this committee, Chairman Grassley asked you point blank, quote,
sentences.zh: 在这个委员会里，格拉斯利主席直截了当地问你，引述如下，

sentences.en: have you ever authorized someone else at the FBI to be an anonymous source in news reports about the Trump investigation or the Clinton administration?
sentences.zh: 你是否曾授权联邦调查局的其他人在关于特朗普调查或克林顿政府的新闻报道中充当匿名消息源？

sentences.en: You responded again under oath.
sentences.zh: 你再次在宣誓下回答。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: You have said before that you did not authorize anyone at the FBI to leak information to reporters.
sentences.zh: 你以前说过，你没有授权联邦调查局的任何人向记者泄露信息。

sentences.en: And just to explain quickly, Cruz is asking about both the Russia investigation and the FBI investigation into Hillary Clinton's use of a private email server.
sentences.zh: 简单解释一下，克鲁斯询问的既有通俄门调查，也有联邦调查局对希拉里·克林顿使用私人电子邮件服务器的调查。

sentences.en: Trump and Republicans, of course, were furious that no charges were brought against Clinton for using that server.
sentences.zh: 特朗普和共和党人当然对克林顿使用该服务器未被起诉感到愤怒。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And Cruz is basically re-raising this issue because, again, remember, a lot of the Trump complaint,
sentences.zh: 克鲁斯基本上是再次提出这个问题，因为，再次提醒大家，特朗普的大部分抱怨，

sentences.en: a lot of the Republican complaint about Jim Comey is that he's a leaker and a liar.
sentences.zh: 共和党人对吉姆·科米的大部分抱怨都是他是个泄密者和骗子。

sentences.en: That's their argument.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们的论点。

sentences.en: And so.
sentences.zh: 所以。

sentences.en: I can only speak to my testimony.
sentences.zh: 我只能对我的证词负责。

sentences.en: I stand by what the testimony you summarized that I gave in May of 2017.
sentences.zh: 我坚持我在2017年5月给出的、你所总结的那些证词。

sentences.en: So your testimony is you've never authorized anyone to leak.
sentences.zh: 所以你的证词是你从未授权任何人泄密。

sentences.en: What Comey says is that's true.
sentences.zh: 科米说这是真的。

sentences.en: I stand by my prior testimony.
sentences.zh: 我坚持我先前的证词。

sentences.en: But mine is the same today.
sentences.zh: 但我今天的证词是一样的。

sentences.en: And that is the thing that the Trump administration, the Justice Department now says was a lie.
sentences.zh: 而这就是特朗普政府和现在的司法部说那是谎言的事情。

sentences.en: A lie because they have evidence, presumably, that they presented to the grand jury that Comey did instruct an aide to leak to the media, presumably.
sentences.zh: 之所以是谎言，是因为他们有证据——大概是他们提交给大陪审团的证据——即科米确实指示了一名助手向媒体泄密，大概吧。

sentences.en: Someone.
sentences.zh: 某个人。

sentences.en: One thing that's important to point out about this indictment is that while we know what the statement is that prosecutors say is a lie, we don't know how it's a lie.
sentences.zh: 关于这份起诉书，有一点很重要，那就是虽然我们知道检察官所说的谎言是什么陈述，但我们不知道它怎么就是谎言了。

sentences.en: The indictment doesn't tell us how this is a lie.
sentences.zh: 起诉书并没有告诉我们这怎么就是谎言。

sentences.en: It's not clear exactly who Comey allegedly authorized to leak information.
sentences.zh: 目前还不清楚科米具体授权谁泄露了信息。

sentences.en: It's not clear what information he supposedly authorized to leak.
sentences.zh: 目前还不清楚他据称授权泄露了什么信息。

sentences.en: So the indictment is very vague on that point.
sentences.zh: 所以起诉书在这点上非常模糊。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: But it is clear that it says that by denying it, Comey lied.
sentences.zh: 但很明显，起诉书称，通过否认这一点，科米撒了谎。

sentences.en: So it sounds like we don't really know what the evidence is based on the indictment that came out tonight.
sentences.zh: 所以听起来，根据今晚发布的起诉书，我们其实并不知道证据到底是什么。

sentences.en: But I do want to reflect on something.
sentences.zh: 但我确实想反思一件事。

sentences.en: All of these Department of Justice lawyers and even their bosses in the first term said this case is weak.
sentences.zh: 所有这些司法部律师，甚至他们在第一任期时的上司，都曾说这个案件很弱。

sentences.en: You shouldn't bring it.
sentences.zh: 你们不应该提起诉讼。

sentences.en: And yet we now have an indictment that was brought and a grand jury that looked at it, evaluated it and said, yes, we should indict Jim Comey.
sentences.zh: 然而现在我们却有了一份被提起的起诉书，还有一个大陪审团审查了它、评估了它，并表示，是的，我们应该起诉吉姆·科米。

sentences.en: So should that tell us that perhaps this case isn't as weak as all of these prosecutors thought it was?
sentences.zh: 那么，这是否应该告诉我们，也许这个案件并不像所有这些检察官想象的那样薄弱？

sentences.en: It's possible.
sentences.zh: 这有可能。

sentences.en: But think back to the old expression, you can indict a ham sandwich, right?
sentences.zh: 但回想一下那句老话，你甚至可以起诉一块火腿三明治，对吧？

sentences.en: There is a cynical joke that it's extremely easy to indict someone.
sentences.zh: 有一个愤世嫉俗的笑话，说起诉某人极其容易。

sentences.en: And that's because of the way the grand jury process works.
sentences.zh: 这正是因为大陪审团程序的运作方式。

sentences.en: Well, just explain that.
sentences.zh: 好吧，请解释一下这一点。

sentences.en: Because prosecutors are the only people who present evidence.
sentences.zh: 因为检察官是唯一呈递证据的人。

sentences.en: They present whatever evidence they want.
sentences.zh: 他们呈递他们想呈递的任何证据。

sentences.en: They don't need the grand jury to be unanimous.
sentences.zh: 他们不需要大陪审团达成一致意见。

sentences.en: They just need, you know, 12 of the grand jurors to say yes to the proposed charges.
sentences.zh: 他们只需要，你知道的，12名大陪审团成员对拟议的指控说同意。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And 12 out of, I think, what, normally 18 or so?
sentences.zh: 而在，我想，通常18人左右中，有12人同意？

sentences.en: It's usually 15 to 18, you know, generally speaking.
sentences.zh: 通常是15到18人，你知道的，一般来说。

sentences.en: And then once you get the indictment, then the real test is obviously in trial.
sentences.zh: 一旦你得到了起诉书，那么真正的考验显然就在审判中了。

sentences.en: But the standard for an indictment is much lower than the standard for a conviction, certainly a trial.
sentences.zh: 但起诉的标准远低于定罪的标准，当然也低于审判的标准。

sentences.en: But so there's all these data points that the history of the case, the resistance from, you know, the career prosecutors indicating that this case is not strong.
sentences.zh: 所以有所有这些数据点，比如案件的历史，来自职业检察官的抵制，这表明这个案件并不强。

sentences.en: The indictment doesn't really tell us whether this case is strong.
sentences.zh: 起诉书并没有真正告诉我们这个案件是否强有力。

sentences.en: It's simply too short and there's not enough detail in it to even make a judgment based on the paper.
sentences.zh: 它实在太短了，里面的细节不够多，甚至无法仅凭书面材料做出判断。

sentences.en: So there's a lot more to unpack about this.
sentences.zh: 所以关于这一点还有很多需要剖析的地方。

sentences.en: And there's, frankly, some of the parts of this we don't know yet.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，其中有些部分我们现在还不知道。

sentences.en: So the fact of an indictment from a grand jury does not necessarily ratify the underlying evidence or tell us how strong or weak it really is.
sentences.zh: 因此，大陪审团提出起诉的事实并不一定能证实潜在的证据，也没有告诉我们它到底有多强或多弱。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: An indictment is just one step in the process.
sentences.zh: 起诉书只是整个过程中的一步。

sentences.en: It's not a resolution or a conclusion.
sentences.zh: 它不是一个解决结果或最终结论。

sentences.en: So there's a lot more that has to play out, particularly in court.
sentences.zh: 所以还有很多事情要上演，特别是在法庭上。

sentences.en: And there's a much bigger fight to be had along the way.
sentences.zh: 在此过程中还会有更激烈的交锋。

sentences.en: And we will talk about that fight and where this case heads next right after the break.
sentences.zh: 我们将在休息之后讨论这场交锋以及这个案件接下来会走向何方。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档全关于对设计的热爱及其周围文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you.
sentences.zh: 甚至早在黑胶唱片时代我在夜店当DJ的时候，每天晚上你都要带着300件你最珍爱的传家宝去工作。

sentences.en: And you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你把一个DJ台变成了这样一个充满活力的快闪博物馆，里面摆满了精美的50年历史的艺术品。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在可以在你喜爱的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: I'm Wynna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写游戏《联群结对》，这是《纽约时报》游戏中的谜题之一。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天都创作拼字游戏《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做色听联觉的病症。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 当我听音乐时，我会看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由你刚才听到的人那样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问nytimes.com斜杠games今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: So, Devlin, where does this indictment go from here?
sentences.zh: 那么，德夫林，这份起诉书接下来会走向何方？

sentences.en: What are the next key steps in this legal process?
sentences.zh: 这个法律程序的下一个关键步骤是什么？

sentences.en: Well, the next step is that Comey will be arraigned in court on this charge in early October, October 9th.
sentences.zh: 嗯，下一步是科米将于10月上旬（10月9日）就这项指控在法庭上接受传讯。

sentences.en: And that will obviously be a dramatic moment, but we won't necessarily learn much or have much play out in court.
sentences.zh: 这显然将是一个戏剧性的时刻，但我们不一定能了解很多或在法庭上看到很多进展。

sentences.en: I do think here, especially given what we know about the internal doubts about the strength of this case,
sentences.zh: 我确实认为在这里，特别鉴于我们所了解的关于对该案件强度的内部怀疑，

sentences.en: I think you're going to see some legal challenges to this indictment before it ever gets to trial.
sentences.zh: 我认为在案件进入审判之前，你会看到对这份起诉书的一些法律质疑。

sentences.en: Essentially, Comey's lawyers are going to attempt to have this tossed out.
sentences.zh: 本质上，科米的律师将试图驳回这起诉讼。

sentences.en: I have to think they will because there's already been so much in the public space about Trump demanding he be charged, about prosecutors saying this is not a strong case.
sentences.zh: 我不得不认为他们会这么做，因为在公共空间里已经有太多关于特朗普要求起诉他、关于检察官说这不是一个强有力的案件的言论了。

sentences.en: It's hard for me to imagine a lawyer who would not do that.
sentences.zh: 我很难想象会有哪个律师不这么做。

sentences.en: Well, let's talk about that, specifically what Trump has said.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们来谈谈这个，特别是特朗普所说过的话。

sentences.en: When we think about this case moving forward and potentially reaching a jury, not a grand jury, a regular old jury,
sentences.zh: 当我们想到这个案件向前推进并可能到达陪审团——不是大陪审团，而是普通的老陪审团——时，

sentences.en: I have to imagine, if it gets to that point, that Comey's lawyers will point to Trump's very public desire to punish Comey,
sentences.zh: 我不得不想象，如果到了那个地步，科米的律师会指出特朗普公开希望惩罚科米的愿望，

sentences.en: including that true social posting, which he says to the attorney general, go after Comey and to his firing of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 包括他在真实社交上发布的帖子，他在其中对司法部长说，去追查科米，以及他解雇了拒绝提起诉讼的美国

sentences.en: attorney who refused to bring the case and say that the motives behind this indictment are corrupt.
sentences.zh: 检察官，并说这起诉书背后的动机是腐败的。

sentences.en: And I wonder how that might play in a courtroom with a jury.
sentences.zh: 我想知道这在法庭上的陪审团面前会如何发挥作用。

sentences.en: So I'll be honest, that issue is more likely to play before the judge than the jury.
sentences.zh: 老实说，这个问题在法官面前审理的可能性大于在陪审团面前。

sentences.en: That's the kind of sort of extraneous to the case itself question that is more likely for a judge to have to wrestle with before a jury does.
sentences.zh: 这类问题有点类似于案件本身之外的问题，法官在陪审团介入之前更有可能需要与之搏斗。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And I'll just say, as a general observation, those types of arguments, political persecution, unfair, selective prosecution, those types of arguments rarely succeed in court.
sentences.zh: 我只想说，作为一个普遍的观察，这类论点——政治迫害、不公正的选择性起诉——这类论点在法庭上很少成功。

sentences.en: But you very rarely see the type of political statements, the type of political pressure brought to bear on this case.
sentences.zh: 但你很少看到这种类型的政治声明，这种施加在这个案件上的政治压力。

sentences.en: And so I don't think the normal course of court business is going to be a good way to think about how this particular case proceeds.
sentences.zh: 所以我不认为正常的法庭业务流程会是思考这个特定案件如何进行的好方法。

sentences.en: I want to put out two scenarios.
sentences.zh: 我想提出两种情景。

sentences.en: The first is one in which this case gets to a jury and a jury decides, despite all the reservations of the prosecutors so far, that James Comey is guilty of perjury.
sentences.zh: 第一种是这个案件进入陪审团，而陪审团尽管到目前为止检察官有所有的保留意见，仍决定詹姆斯·科米犯有伪证罪。

sentences.en: Just contemplate for a moment what that would mean and what it would represent.
sentences.zh: 只要花一点时间思考一下这意味着什么，以及它代表了什么。

sentences.en: Well, I think first of all, it would represent an amazing moment in this entire saga between Trump and Comey,
sentences.zh: 好吧，我认为首先，它将代表特朗普和科米之间、

sentences.en: between Trump and the Justice Department, and between Trump and the legal system writ large.
sentences.zh: 特朗普和司法部之间、以及特朗普与整个法律体系之间整个传奇故事中的一个惊人时刻。

sentences.en: This was a president who last year was facing four indictments.
sentences.zh: 这是一位去年面临四起起诉书的总统。

sentences.en: And this year has successfully gotten his Justice Department to indict the person he probably blames most for his legal problems, whether or not that's fair.
sentences.zh: 而今年，他成功地让他的司法部起诉了他可能最指责其法律问题的人，不管这是否公平。

sentences.en: And so I think a conviction in this case, which I think is far from certain,
sentences.zh: 所以我认为在这个案件中的定罪——我认为这还远未确定——

sentences.en: would be sort of a moment of triumph for Trump in this battle that has gone on for seven, eight years and counting.
sentences.zh: 对于特朗普在已经持续了七八年且还在继续的这场战斗中来说，将是一种胜利的时刻。

sentences.en: And I think a lot of people who have worked at the Justice Department, who have worked at the FBI, already view the indictment as a very sad and frustrating event.
sentences.zh: 我认为许多曾在司法部工作过、曾在联邦调查局工作过的人，已经将这份起诉书视为一个非常悲伤和令人沮丧的事件。

sentences.en: And I think any sort of conviction that drew out of this would be 10 times more so.
sentences.zh: 我认为由此产生的任何定罪都将是十倍以上的痛苦。

sentences.en: Well, you're bringing me to the second scenario and the question I have about that,
sentences.zh: 好吧，你把我带到了第二种情景以及我对此提出的问题，

sentences.en: which is let's presume for a moment that Comey is not convicted or that the case never even reaches a jury.
sentences.zh: 那就是我们暂且假设科米没有被定罪，或者案件甚至从未到达陪审团。

sentences.en: As you're hinting at, for some people, including some people inside the Department of Justice, even if it's tossed out, this is a case where for them a red line has been crossed.
sentences.zh: 正如你所暗示的，对某些人来说，包括司法部内部的一些人，即使它被驳回，这也是一个对他们来说越过了红线的案件。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, I've had people say to me, a number of current and former DOJ lawyers say to me, the Justice Department, as I knew it, is dead.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，有人对我说过，许多现任和前任司法部律师对我说过，我所了解的司法部已经死了。

sentences.en: That is very much the fear of a lot of people who either used to work there or currently work there and are worried,
sentences.zh: 这正是许多曾经在那里工作或目前在那里工作并感到担忧的人的恐惧，

sentences.en: greatly worried about the way in which Trump seems to be getting everything he wants or most of what he wants from the Justice Department.
sentences.zh: 他们极大地担忧特朗普似乎正在从司法部得到他想要的一切或大部分他想要的东西的方式。

sentences.en: And, you know, look, what he wants clearly in the Comey case and clearly in other cases is he wants retribution.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，看吧，他在科米案中显然想要什么，在其他案件中也显然想要什么，那就是他想要报复。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, what he has articulated and what it sounds like to these lawyers he has succeeded in doing
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他所阐明的以及在这些律师听来他已经成功做到的事情，

sentences.en: is turning animus towards his enemies into really the modus operandi of the Department of Justice
sentences.zh: 是将对敌人的敌意真正变成了司法部的行事方式，

sentences.en: and in doing so, turning an institution that for decades viewed its independence from the president
sentences.zh: 通过这样做，将一个几十年来将其对总统的独立性视作基石原则的机构，

sentences.en: as really a bedrock principle into an institution that openly now takes its orders directly from the president, where that independence is now vanished.
sentences.zh: 变成了一个现在公开直接听命于总统的机构，那种独立性现在已经烟消云散了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: One of the things that I think is changing all the time at this Justice Department is what people work on and what people care most about.
sentences.zh: 我认为在这个司法部里不断改变的事情之一，就是人们在为什么工作，以及人们最关心什么。

sentences.en: And every day, I think the people giving the orders in the department and taking the orders in the department
sentences.zh: 而且每一天，我认为部里下达命令的人和在部里接受命令的人

sentences.en: would agree that more and more of their work is to do what President Trump wants, period.
sentences.zh: 都会同意，他们越来越多的工作就是做特朗普总统想要做的事，句号。

sentences.en: And, you know, for some, for a lot of the people receiving the orders, that is a very disturbing and upsetting proposition.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，对一些人来说，对许多接受命令的人来说，这是一个非常令人不安和沮丧的命题。

sentences.en: And for a lot of the people in the department who are giving the orders, they believe that's what they're there to do.
sentences.zh: 而对于部里许多下达命令的人来说，他们相信这就是他们来到这里的职责。

sentences.en: From everything you've said, there are career prosecutors in the Department of Justice,
sentences.zh: 从你所说的一切来看，司法部里有职业检察官，

sentences.en: including in the office prosecuting this case right now in Virginia, who never wanted this indictment to reach this point.
sentences.zh: 包括现在正在弗吉尼亚州起诉此案的办公室里的检察官，他们从未希望这份起诉书走到这一步。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So what is your expectation of what they will do now?
sentences.zh: 那么你对他们现在会做什么有什么期望？

sentences.en: Look, I think one of the most important details of what happened in this indictment is that no career prosecutor signed it.
sentences.zh: 听着，我认为这起诉书中发生的事情最重要的细节之一，就是没有职业检察官在上面签字。

sentences.en: It is only signed by Trump's handpicked new head of the office.
sentences.zh: 它只由特朗普亲自挑选的新办公室负责人签字。

sentences.en: Is that unusual?
sentences.zh: 这不寻常吗？

sentences.en: That's very unusual.
sentences.zh: 这非常不寻常。

sentences.en: So perhaps an act of proteSt.
sentences.zh: 所以也许这是一种抗议的行为。

sentences.en: An act of protest and an unwillingness to put your name on something that you don't believe in.
sentences.zh: 这是一种抗议的行为，也是一种不愿意在你不相信的事情上签名的方式。

sentences.en: In addition to that, right after the indictment became public, one lawyer in that office resigned.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，就在起诉书公开后不久，该办公室的一名律师辞职了。

sentences.en: Now, that lawyer in that office happens to be Mr. Comey's son-in-law.
sentences.zh: 现在，该办公室的那名律师恰好是科米先生的女婿。

sentences.en: Small world.
sentences.zh: 世界真小。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And he basically said, look, I am leaving to uphold the Constitution and my duty to my country.
sentences.zh: 他基本上说，听着，我离开是为了维护宪法和我对国家的职责。

sentences.en: So I would not be at all surprised if you see other resignations come as a result of this indictment.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你看到由于这份起诉书而出现其他辞职，我一点也不会感到惊讶。

sentences.en: And I will tell you, in the entirety of this year,
sentences.zh: 我得告诉你，在这一整年里，

sentences.en: there are a lot of DOJ lawyers who have had to make tough choices about resign or be fired because they're unwilling to do things that they are told to do that they think are unethical for lawyers or just plain wrong.
sentences.zh: 有许多司法部律师不得不做出艰难的选择，是辞职还是被解雇，因为他们不愿意做被告知要做的事情，他们认为这些事情对律师来说是不道德的，或者根本就是错误的。

sentences.en: You talk to these prosecutors all the time.
sentences.zh: 你一直在与这些检察官交谈。

sentences.en: I wonder what you've gleaned about how they're thinking about this.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你对他们的想法有什么了解。

sentences.en: If they leave, they're likely to be replaced by lawyers more and more loyal to the president, more and more inclined to bring cases like the one against Comey.
sentences.zh: 如果他们离开，他们很可能会被对总统越来越忠诚、越来越倾向于提起像针对科米这样的诉讼的律师所取代。

sentences.en: If they stay, then perhaps they have to bring those cases themselves.
sentences.zh: 如果他们留下来，那么也许他们必须自己提起这些诉讼。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I have talked to countless people wrestling with that very question.
sentences.zh: 我曾与无数纠结于这个问题的 人交谈过。

sentences.en: Is it more honorable to stay and try to make things better or is it more honorable to leave or be fired, resisting things that they think are truly bad and unacceptable?
sentences.zh: 是留下来试图让事情变得更好更光荣，还是离开或被解雇、抵制他们认为真正糟糕且不可接受的事情更光荣？

sentences.en: I have seen people come down all over the map on that question for them personally and for whichever case in particular is sort of they feel is forcing them to make that kind of choice.
sentences.zh: 我看到人们在个人层面上以及针对他们认为迫使他们做出这种选择的特定案件时，在这个问题上持各种各样的观点。

sentences.en: I will say there are a couple of dynamics to this.
sentences.zh: 我要说的是，这里有几个动态。

sentences.en: One is I think at this point,
sentences.zh: 一个是我认为在这一点上，

sentences.en: the people faced with those choices are pretty pessimistic about what's happening to the department and what will continue to happen to the department.
sentences.zh: 面临这些选择的人对司法部正在发生的事情以及将继续发生的事情感到相当悲观。

sentences.en: And so I think you're going to see a lot more people leave just for all sorts of issues.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为你会看到更多的人因为各种各样的问题而离开。

sentences.en: And two,
sentences.zh: 第二，

sentences.en: I think one of the things you're seeing all around the system is growing skepticism from judges and even some jurors and grand jurors about the merits of what Trump's Justice Department is doing.
sentences.zh: 我认为你在整个系统周围看到的事情之一，是法官甚至一些陪审员和大陪审员对特朗普司法部正在做的事情的价值越来越怀疑。

sentences.en: That has been growing as well through this process.
sentences.zh: 在整个过程中，这种怀疑也在不断增长。

sentences.en: There are significant instances already of jurors saying no, of judges criticizing prosecutorial decisions.
sentences.zh: 已经有陪审员说不、法官批评检察官决定的重大实例。

sentences.en: There's ever reason to think that that will continue and perhaps intensify.
sentences.zh: 我们有充分的理由认为这种情况将继续下去，并可能会加剧。

sentences.en: Devlin,
sentences.zh: 德夫林，

sentences.en: I just want to end by going back to the president's true social post in which he pretty much ordered his attorney general to pursue more of these kinds of cases to indict more of his enemies like Comey.
sentences.zh: 我只想以回到总统的真实社交帖子来结束，他在该帖子中几乎命令他的司法部长追求更多这类案件，起诉更多像科米这样的敌人。

sentences.en: And we know, based on the reporting of people like you, who he has his eyes on, Adam Schiff for the role he played in Trump's impeachment, Letitia James,
sentences.zh: 我们知道，根据像你这样的人的报道，他正盯着亚当·希夫在特朗普弹劾案中所扮演的角色，还有莱蒂蒂亚·詹姆斯，

sentences.en: the attorney general of New York for the cases she's brought against Trump, Hillary Clinton for being a political foe who he has always loathed, George Soros, a liberal donor.
sentences.zh: 包括纽约州总检察长及其针对特朗普提起诉讼的案件，希拉里·克林顿因他是其一直厌恶的政治对手，还有自由派捐款人乔治·索罗斯。

sentences.en: How far, in the end, do we think this is actually going to go?
sentences.zh: 归根结底，我们认为这件事最终会发展到什么地步？

sentences.en: I think in the Comey case, you see an instance where he has, you know, in some ways broken through and gotten exactly what he's always wanted out of this Justice Department,
sentences.zh: 我认为在科米案中，你会看到这样一个例子：你知道，他在某种程度上取得了突破，得到了他一直想从这个司法部得到的东西，

sentences.en: out of what he views as his Justice Department.
sentences.zh: 从他所认为的“他的司法部”那里。

sentences.en: But also, the same day Comey's indicted,
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，就在科米被起诉的同一天，

sentences.en: Trump also signs a memorandum basically telling all these government agencies to investigate what he calls this vast conspiracy to sow violence on the streets of America.
sentences.zh: 特朗普还签署了一份备忘录，基本上指示所有这些政府机构去调查他所谓的在全美街道煽动暴力的巨大阴谋。

sentences.en: We reported on the same day that there's this order going out to try to build a case against George Soros' foundation on similar terMs.
sentences.zh: 我们报道过，在同一天，有一项命令下达，试图以类似的条款针对乔治·索罗斯的基金会建立案宗。

sentences.en: He has a lot of people he wants investigated.
sentences.zh: 他有一长串想要调查的人。

sentences.en: He has a lot of people that he demands be thrown in jail.
sentences.zh: 他有许多要求被投入大牢的人。

sentences.en: There's no reason to think that this will stop with Jim Comey.
sentences.zh: 没有理由认为这会以吉姆·科米告终。

sentences.en: And I think the process that we've watched, the things we're following,
sentences.zh: 而且我认为我们所目睹的过程、我们正在追踪的事态，

sentences.en: give every reason to think the indictment of Jim Comey is the start of what this Justice Department is going to do.
sentences.zh: 有充分的理由让人认为，对吉姆·科米的起诉只是这个司法部即将采取行动的开始。

sentences.en: Well, Devlin, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，德夫林，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: On Thursday night, President Trump celebrated Comey's indictment in a social media post, calling it, quote, justice in America,
sentences.zh: 周四晚上，特朗普总统在社交媒体发帖庆祝科米被起诉，称其为“美国的正义”，引述如下，

sentences.en: and describing Comey as one of the worst human beings this country has ever been exposed to.
sentences.zh: 并形容科米是这个国家所见过最糟糕的人类之一。

sentences.en: Soon after.
sentences.zh: 不久之后。

sentences.en: My family and I have known for years that there are costs to standing up to Donald Trump, but we couldn't imagine ourselves living any other way.
sentences.zh: 我的家人和我多年来一直知道，挺身对抗唐纳德·特朗普是有代价的，但我们无法想象自己会以任何其他方式生活。

sentences.en: Comey himself posted a response to the indictment.
sentences.zh: 科米本人发布了对起诉书的回应。

sentences.en: Somebody that I love dearly recently said that fear is the tool of a tyrant, and she's right, but I'm not afraid, and I hope you're not either.
sentences.zh: 我深爱的人最近说过，恐惧是暴君的工具，她是正确的，但我并不害怕，我也希望你们都不是。

sentences.en: In which he lamented the state of the Justice Department under President Trump, but said that he was unafraid of his indictment.
sentences.zh: 他在其中对特朗普总统领导下的司法部现状表示痛惜，但表示他不惧怕自己的起诉。

sentences.en: My heart is broken for the Department of Justice, but I have great confidence in the federal judicial system, and I'm innocent.
sentences.zh: 我为司法部感到心碎，但我对联邦司法系统充满信心，我是无辜的。

sentences.en: So let's have a trial and keep the faith.
sentences.zh: 所以让我们进行审判，保持信念。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他消息。

sentences.en: He called the ICE employees people showing up to collect a dirty paycheck.
sentences.zh: 他称移民及海关执法局的员工为“来领黑心钱的人”。

sentences.en: On Thursday, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 周四，美国

sentences.en: attorney for Texas said that notes left by the suspected shooter at an ICE facility in Dallas made clear that his target were ICE agents and personnel,
sentences.zh: 德克萨斯州检察官表示，嫌疑枪手在达拉斯的一处移民及海关执法局设施留下的便条明确指出，他的目标是移民及海关执法局的特工和人员，

sentences.en: not the three detainees that he ultimately shot.
sentences.zh: 而不是他最终枪击的那三名被扣留人员。

sentences.en: He wrote that he intended to maximize lethality against ICE personnel and to maximize property damage at the facility.
sentences.zh: 他写道，他旨在最大程度地杀伤移民及海关执法局人员，并最大程度地破坏该设施的财产。

sentences.en: It seems that he did not intend to kill the detainees or harm them.
sentences.zh: 看来他并不打算杀死或伤害那些被扣留人员。

sentences.en: One of those detainees later died from his injuries.
sentences.zh: 其中一名被扣留人员后来因伤势过重死亡。

sentences.en: And President Trump has announced a new round of tariffs against imported pharmaceuticals, semi-trucks, kitchen cabinets, and furniture that will take effect on October 1St.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统宣布对进口药品、半挂卡车、厨房橱柜和家具实施新一轮关税，将于10月1日生效。

sentences.en: The tariffs on pharmaceuticals have raised fears of higher prices on widely used drugs, but the White House said that best-selling medicines would be exempt.
sentences.zh: 药品的关税引发了人们对常用药价格上涨的担忧，但白宫表示，最畅销的药物将被豁免。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Rob Zipko, Shannon Lynn, and Mooj Zadie.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由罗布·齐普科、香农·林恩和穆吉·扎迪制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Patricia Willans, with help from Rachel Quester and Rob Zipko.
sentences.zh: 由帕特里夏·威兰斯剪辑，雷切尔·奎斯特和罗布·齐普科提供协助。

sentences.en: It contains original music by Dan Powell and was engineered by Alyssa Moxley.
sentences.zh: 它包含丹·鲍威尔的原创音乐，由阿莉莎·莫克斯利担任音频工程。

sentences.en: The Daily's engineers are Chris Wood and Alyssa Moxley, with engineering support from Brad Fisher, Matty Maciello, Nick Pittman, and Kyle Grandillo.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报每日简报》的音频工程师是克里斯·伍德和阿莉莎·莫克斯利，并由布拉德·费舍尔、马蒂·马切洛、尼克·皮特曼和凯尔·格兰迪洛提供工程支持。

sentences.en: Our theme song is by Ben Landsfork and Jim Brunberg of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题曲由来自Wonderly的本·兰兹福克和吉姆·布鲁恩伯格创作。

sentences.en: Our radio team is Jody Becker, Rowan Emisto, Diane Wong, and Katherine Anderson.
sentences.zh: 我们的广播团队是乔迪·贝克尔、罗温·埃米斯托、黛安·黄和凯瑟琳·安德森。

sentences.zh: 亚历山德拉·李·杨是我们的执行副制片人。

sentences.zh: 迈克尔·勒努瓦是我们的副主编。

sentences.zh: 佩奇·科维特是《纽约时报每日简报》的主编。

sentences.en: Ben Calhoun is our executive producer.
sentences.zh: 本·卡尔霍恩是我们的执行制片人。

sentences.en: Special thanks to Paula Schumann, Larissa Anderson, Sam Dolmick, and to the founding editor of the show, Lisa Tobin.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢宝拉·舒曼、拉丽莎·安德森、萨姆·多尔米克，以及节目的创始主编丽莎·托宾。

sentences.zh: 这就是《纽约时报每日简报》的全部内容。

sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: See you on Monday.
sentences.zh: 周一见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》中，我们正在为节假日的招待做好准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让你的客人在家一般自在的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要全然黑暗才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会不会为了睡觉而昏迷过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的要求。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有对什么过敏吗，对食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶的人？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》App或你喜欢的任何地方查找《Wirecutter秀》。
